notes:
## 0.2.255

owes: none — `notes.*` records are written as NotesManager `SPEC-10-sync-wire.md` (amended 2026-10-11) requires (SPEC-178): an item's `orderKey` of `0.0`, a `createdAt` of `0` and an empty attachment's `sizeBytes` of `0` are now written, so the phone reads back what the hub rewrote; `list_layout` is stored as `CARDS`/`LIST`, so a layout the browser saved before this release reads as unset and shows as tiles until it is chosen again; a note record with no `v`, `v: 0`, an `id` that is not its record's, a malformed attachment digest, or a required field missing (a note holding an empty file the hub wrote before this release) is now counted unreadable instead of shown; no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
owes: SyncDesk — the interface model is at `uiModel` 9 (SPEC-170): a text field gains `suggestions`, a list of value and label pairs offered while it is typed into (an editable combo box, or the nearest control; empty draws the field as before), and `stocks.settings` draws the reference currency as a setting form with twelve suggested codes and the action `stocks.settings.currency{value}`, which the engine runs as `stocks.setSetting{key: "reference_currency", value}`. The hub now writes `reference_currency` (three ASCII letters stored upper-case, empty removes the record, anything else `-32602`) beside the four addresses; `poll_interval_hours` stays read only. No migration, no configuration key, rollback safe (the phone's own key and payload).
owes: SyncDesk — the interface model is at `uiModel` 10 (SPEC-172 stage 2): `region.style` is gone for a closed `arrangement` (`stack`, `grid`, `column`, `columns`, `panel`, and `page` for the sensor page), `figures.style` for `arrangement` (`strip`, `tiles`), and a `heading` takes `level` (`section`, `group`); a `section` takes `style` (`page`, `card` a collapsible card, `group` a heading with a menu of its `commands` after its `rename`, `fold` a closed fold inside a section), a `paragraph` `kind` (`plain`, `note` under a tile, `hint` under a heading), an `actions` block `foot` (text buttons in a panel's foot), a `card` `bar` (its heading as a head bar) and an `emptyState` `primary` (its command is the main button). The watchlist's category is now a `group` section, a place a `panel` region, an instrument's holding a `bar` card holding a `strip`, the headlines, the three alerts lists and the page analysis head-bar cards, the news a `panel` with *Load more* an `actions` block under it, and the sensor form the generic `form` (`primary: save`); a list's `link` is no longer set by these. The web is unchanged to the eye except that the sensor form's label field is as wide as the others.
owes: SyncDesk — the engine zip carries `ui-geometry.json` beside `ui-strings/` (SPEC-172 stage 1): `Geometry`'s tokens in px (`space1`…`space6`, `rhythm`, `gutter`, `gutterNarrow`, `bottomClearance`, `widthReading` as `{"characters": 72}`, `widthStandard`, `widthData`, `widthWide` null, `columnMax`, `tileMin`, `gridMaxColumns`, `gridGap`, `panelPadding`, the three breakpoints, `headerHeight`), and every `Screen` gains `width` (`reading`, `standard`, `data`, `wide`; default `standard`). The web is unchanged to the eye.
owes: SyncDesk — the interface model is at `uiModel` 11 (SPEC-174): the panel's footer opens with *App backups* (`nav.appBackups`, the new `backup` icon token, destination `backups`, no dot), *App backups* is no longer a row of Settings and its page has no back path (it is a panel destination now); `/backups` lists eight sections, one per backup app (feed, weather, stocks, notes, files, flights, sound, tennis, each with the new `section.icon` — an `app:<slug>` token — and, with nothing kept, *No backup on the hub yet.* and a folded *How to turn it on*), then any slug the hub does not know. The engine zip's `ui-strings/` gains `nav.appBackups`, `appBackups.*` and `backupApp.*` and loses `appBackups.none` and `settings.appBackups.desc`. The hub serves `/static/icon-files.svg`, `icon-flights.svg`, `icon-sound.svg` and `icon-tennis.svg`; SyncDesk draws `app:files|flights|sound|tennis` from the engine's own copies.
owes: none — the hub's guide (SPEC-180): *Guide* is About's first link, `/guide` and `/guide/{anchor}` read the five copies of the guide shipped in the image; a read-only page, nothing to configure, rollback safe. The guide itself is written in io: a release that changes what it describes owes its update there, then a refreshed copy here.
owes: SyncDesk — the interface model is at `uiModel` 13 (SPEC-181): an `instrument` row gains `meta`, the line a list row draws in place of the bare symbol (*symbol · time since the quote was refreshed*, the age alone for an instrument with no chart symbol, the symbol alone for one never fetched; null with neither); a negative age is now said as none. The web's list layout draws it in the symbol cell; cards and the instrument page are unchanged. No migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
owes: none — the tennis news opening page compiles again (a missing import of `Messages.text` in `TennisRoutes.kt`); no behaviour change, no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
owes: a migration — schema V035 (`tennis_fetch_health`, `tennis_keys`, SPEC-176), forward-only: an older image refuses a database at 35, so a rollback after the first start needs a snapshot taken before it. A new collection family on the wire: `tennis.favorites`, `tournament_follows`, `followed_matches`, `read_articles` and `settings` sync like any app's (the phone's own wire bytes, decoded through `com.mambocoding.tennis:core` 0.5.36), and `tennis.shared_day_cards`, `shared_calendar`, `shared_rankings` and `shared_news` are the hub's (a push to them is refused, no phone pulls them). `tennis` is a served app, off until Settings → Apps switches it on, and leaves the backup-only list (`/backups` lists it fifth, named *Tennis*; the string `backupApp.tennis` is gone). The keyed-fixture key is typed on `/tennis/settings`, sealed by `SYNCHUB_SECRET_KEY` (a hub without one refuses to store it; a key imported on another hub must open `tennis_keys.secret_encrypted` too, SPEC-145) and sent as the `APIkey` query parameter of the account's own `keyed_fixture_address`, redacted from every log line and stored text. No configuration key, rollback to the previous image leaves the tables unread.
owes: SyncDesk — `uiModel` 14 (SPEC-177): the tennis app (`tennis`, in the panel after notes) with six destinations — `tennis.today` `/tennis`, `tennis.follows` `/tennis/follows` (`q`), `tennis.calendar`, `tennis.rankings`, `tennis.news` (`open`), `tennis.settings` — all `needsSession`; four row kinds, `match`, `player`, `tournament` and `rankingEntry`; the news list reuses `newsItem`, and `tennis.news` carries *Mark all as read* in its action bar. New actions, each an engine method relayed to `/api/v1/tennis/*`: `tennis.follow.player`, `tennis.follow.mute`, `tennis.follow.playerRemove`, `tennis.follow.tournament`, `tennis.follow.round`, `tennis.follow.tournamentRemove`, `tennis.follow.matchRemove`, `tennis.news.readAll`, `tennis.setSetting`, `tennis.setKey` (a credential, never logged), `tennis.search`; a write based on a stale `revision` answers `409`. `GET /tennis/players/search?q=` (and its `/api/v1` twin) answers `{players:[{id,name,tour?,imageUrl?}]}`, `429` past ten a minute. The engine zip's `ui-strings/` gains `tennis.*`, `nav.app.tennis` and `setup.appDesc.tennis` and loses `backupApp.tennis`; `app:tennis` is drawn from the engine's own copy of `icon-tennis.svg`. A password field is now drawn in a setting form. No configuration key.
owes: a migration — schema V034 (`scope_requests`, SPEC-175); a rollback to the previous release leaves the table unread and a pending request unanswered
owes: SyncDesk — `uiModel` 12 (SPEC-175): the Devices body carries a `card` per backup-only device asking to sync, above the table, with *Allow* (`devices.scopeAllow`, `POST /api/v1/devices/own/{id}/scope-request/allow`) and *Refuse* (`devices.scopeRefuse`), and the panel's *Settings* entry takes an amber dot while one is pending; `devices.list` rows gain `scopeRequest` (`pending` or absent). Strings `devices.scopeRequest.*` in five locales. The phone side: `POST /devices/scope` with `scope=full` from a backup token answers `202` (it was `403`), `GET /devices/scope/request` answers `none`, `pending`, `refused` or `allowed` with a new `token` that replaces the old at its first use, `GET /hub/status` names the token's `scope`; an app with no module here answers `409 no_module`.
owes: a migration — schema V033 (`devices.scope`, `pairing_codes.max_scope`), forward-only; a rollback after the first start needs a backup taken before it, and an older image reads every device as full-scope (SPEC-173). A device token now has a scope: `POST /devices/pair/complete-scoped` mints a `backup` token bound to one app slug (`invalid_scope`, `invalid_app` and `scope_exceeds_code` leave the code usable), `POST /devices/pair/delegate` mints a code capped at the endorser's scope, `POST /devices/scope` narrows a token's own scope (`scope_escalation` for a wider one, `no_app` without a stored app). A backup token reaches `/backups/<its app>`, the blob upload, a blob its own entries name and `/hub/status` (version and account only); every other device route answers `403 {"error":"scope_backup"}`, and a backup device counts toward no tombstone floor, no *App sync* dot and no *+ Add*. Settings → Devices tags it *Backup only*; `GET /api/v1/devices/own` rows gain `scope`.
owes: schema migration V032 (`sessions.device_id`), forward-only — a rollback after the first start needs a backup taken before it (SPEC-171). `POST /api/v1/session` takes an optional `deviceToken` (the signing-in account's own; another's, an unknown or a revoked one is `403` and creates no session), the session is deleted with its device, and `GET /api/v1/account/sessions` rows gain `device`; Account → Sessions gains a *Device* column once a session is bound. No configuration key.
owes: SyncDesk — `session.signIn` takes `remember` (default false): true sends the engine's own device token, binds the session to the device and keeps the token and the roles in `<dir>/session.json` (`rw-------` where the filesystem has that model), read at start with no request to the hub; `session.status` and `session.changed` gain `remembered`. The file is deleted on sign-out, `unpair`, a revoked device, a 401 on a relay and a sign-in without `remember`. SyncDesk's sign-in page sends `remember` from its *Stay signed in on this PC* box (SyncDesk SPEC-16 §6).
owes: none — About → Update no longer shows the *launcher behind* warning and its three commands (SPEC-179): the launcher follows every applied update by itself; no key, collection, migration or default changes.
owes: none — comments, one test name and the specs say DataCore where they said FeedCore; no code path, wire, configuration key or migration changes.
owes: none — build and agent tooling only: `tooling/` re-pinned v0.1.20 → v0.1.21 and the `preflight@` ref in `release.yml` follows (Tooling's interval is `owes: none`: the QA catalogue upkeep rule and an optional QA trunk); `syncprotocol` and `synccore` re-pinned 0.10.7 → 0.10.8 and `feedcore`, `weathercore` and `stockscore` 0.5.33 → 0.5.36 (SyncCore's and DataCore's intervals are `owes: none` for the hub; the `notes:core` pin is added for SPEC-178).
